changesRequestedReviews.body: Please rebase and address the threading concerns raised in review.

instructions: Review each item under `## Changes-requested reviews` and decide whether it needs a code change.
The branch has merge conflicts (see `**branch**` above). Resolve them before committing.
Read every body under `## Changes-requested reviews` and apply any warranted change.

For any substantial decision or rejection, append `- <decision>` to Shepherd Journal with `pr-shepherd apply journal https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/42 '- <decision>'`. See "Shepherd Journal" in the pr-shepherd skill for citation conventions.
`[FIX_CODE]` requires a push after conflict resolution. Commit and push the resolved changes, then iterate again once the remote PR head reflects your push.
